process: president elected by Hellenic Parliament for a 5-year term (eligible for a second term); president appoints as prime minister the leader of the majority party or coalition in the Hellenic Parliament
results: 2025: Konstantinos TASOULAS (ND) elected president by Parliament - 160 of 300 votes; 2020: Katerina SAKELLAROPOULOU (independent) elected president by Parliament - 261 of 300 votes
cabinet: Cabinet appointed by the president on the recommendation of the prime minister
